title: Starshadow Splash
description: Starshadow Splash for the nerd in all of us that wants to see things loading
body:
# ★ Starshadow Splash

### Watch your mods load — in style.

Tired of staring at the same boring Mojang logo while your modpack boots? **Starshadow Splash** replaces the vanilla loading screen with a beautiful, real-time boot log that shows exactly what's happening as your game starts up.

> *"Like watching the Matrix, but for Minecraft mods."*

---

## 🪄 How It Works

1. **Install the mod** and launch Minecraft
2. **Watch the magic** — a scrolling boot log appears, showing each mod as it initializes
3. **See everything** — timestamps, init times, memory usage, mod count
4. **Jump in** — press any key or click to skip straight to the title screen

That's it. No setup. No config needed. Just a better loading experience.

---

## ✨ Features

### 📜 Real-Time Boot Log
Watch your mods initialize one by one in a scrolling console-style display. Each mod gets its own line with initialization time, so you can spot which mods are slow.

### 🎨 Three Display Modes
- **Detailed** — Full scrolling boot log with per-mod initialization lines (default)
- **Summary** — Static info card showing mod count and system info
- **Vanilla** — Standard Mojang logo splash screen (disables Starshadow rendering)

### ⏱️ Smart Pacing
The boot log replay adjusts its scroll speed to match your actual loading time:
- **Adaptive** — Automatically adjusts speed to finish when loading completes (default)
- **Comfortable** — Fixed pace at your configured lines-per-second rate
- **Fast** — Faster fixed pace for those who like speed

### 📊 At-a-Glance Info
- **Timestamps** before each log line (e.g., `[0.032]`)
- **Init times** showing how long each mod took to initialize
- **Memory gauge** in the footer showing current heap usage
- **Mod count** so you always know your modpack size

### ⏸️ Pause Until Ready
Enable "Pause Until Input" to keep the boot log visible until you press a key or click. Perfect for reading through your mod list or checking init times before the title screen appears.

### ⚙️ Fully Configurable
Every aspect of the splash screen can be tweaked:
- Display mode (Detailed / Summary / Vanilla)
- Pacing mode and scroll speed (1–20 lines per second)
- Ready pause duration (0–10 seconds)
- Toggle timestamps, init times, and memory gauge individually
- All settings accessible via Mod Menu or the config file

---

## 📥 Get It

### Recommended: Modrinth

[**Download on Modrinth**](https://modrinth.com/mod/starshadow-splash) — the preferred platform for Starshadow Splash.

### Also available on CurseForge

[**Download on CurseForge**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/starshadow-splash) — same mod, same releases.

---

## 📦 Installation

### From Modrinth (recommended)

1. Go to the [Starshadow Splash Modrinth page](https://modrinth.com/mod/starshadow-splash)
2. Select your **Minecraft version** (1.20.1, 1.20.4, or 1.21.1)
3. Click **Install** — dependencies are installed automatically if using a compatible launcher
4. Launch and enjoy the new boot screen! 🚀

### Manual Install

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) for your Minecraft version
2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Drop the following into your `mods/` folder:
   - **Starshadow Splash** `.jar`
   - **Starshadow Config** `.jar` (required dependency)
   - **Starshadow Lib** `.jar` (required dependency)
4. (Optional) Install [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) or **Starshadow Menu** to access settings in-game — either one works, you don't need both
5. Launch Minecraft! 🚀

> **Supported:** Minecraft 1.20.1 · 1.20.4 · 1.21.1 — Fabric only

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

All settings are accessible via **Mod Menu** → Starshadow Splash → Settings, or by editing `config/starshadow-splash.json` directly.

| Setting | Default | Options |
|---------|---------|---------|
| **Splash Mode** | Detailed | Detailed · Summary · Vanilla |
| **Show All Mods** | ✅ On | On · Off |
| **Pacing Mode** | Adaptive | Adaptive · Comfortable · Fast |
| **Lines Per Second** | 4 | 1–20 |
| **Ready Pause** | 3 seconds | 0–10 seconds |
| **Pause Until Input** | Off | On · Off |
| **Show Timestamps** | ✅ On | On · Off |
| **Show Init Times** | ✅ On | On · Off |
| **Show Memory** | ✅ On | On · Off |

---

## 🧩 Compatibility

| Mod | Compatibility |
|-----|-------------|
| **Fabric API** | ✅ Required |
| **Mod Menu** | ✅ Optional — config screen integration (not needed if Starshadow Menu is installed) |
| **Starshadow Menu** | ✅ Optional — provides config screen access and mod list |
| **Other splash mods** | ⚠️ May conflict — only one splash overlay should be active |

---

## 📋 Requirements

| Dependency | Required? |
|-----------|-----------|
| **Fabric Loader** | ✅ Yes |
| **Fabric API** | ✅ Yes |
| **Starshadow Config** | ✅ Yes |
| **Starshadow Lib** | ✅ Yes |
| **Mod Menu** or **Starshadow Menu** | Optional — either provides config screen access |

---

## 🌟 Make Loading Fun Again

No more staring at a static logo wondering if your game crashed. **Starshadow Splash** turns the most boring part of Minecraft into something you'll actually enjoy watching.

Download it. Watch your mods boot. Marvel at how fast (or slow) they are.
